Table 2: Main results on AdaMem-Bench, grouped by feedback mode (Explicit / Implicit), reporting QA accuracy, Extraction F1, MER, and memory volume (Vol.). Reference bounds (Full Context, Ideal Memory) are extractorindependent (QA by deepseek-v4-flash); Mem0 and AdaMem are reported under each extraction model. Gains in parentheses are relative to the corresponding Mem0. Full Context stores no memory, so its F1/MER are undefined.

Figure 1: Motivating results on AdaMem-Bench (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Explicit feedback). Accuracy over 10 weeks (smoothed with window w = 3). Ideal Memory and AdaMem maintain high performance, while the uniform Mem0 baseline degrades over time.
